g.text: Stage 3 victory run (runs/stage-3/victory.txt), turns 4 to 7, then the result check after turn 18.
Only the calls for Victor (#2, VIP) are drawn. The other customers go through the same calls.
The manager's choice: Happy Hour on in turn 4. Victor then pays $10.80 instead of $13.50
and pays with satisfaction 100 instead of 95. runs/stage-3/happy-hour-late.txt is the same game
with Happy Hour saved for turn 13. When the controller refuses a choice, the CLI says why
and asks the same staff member again.
each staff member can do one task again
